svg.text: runtime panic → defer/recover • returned error → Is/As • nested error → %w/Unwrap

text.tspan: Out-of-range slice access.
Nil pointer dereference.
Source summary also names mutex/file failures.
Runtime prints panic info and stack trace.
panic(v) can be called explicitly.
Register defer before panic-producing point.
Deferred call executes on panic path.
Source motivation: close file/socket/etc.
A defer statement after panic is never reached.
Cleanup and panic handling are separate concerns.
recover() is called inside deferred handler.
Non-nil result means panic was observed.
Example logs and continues execution.
Handler may generate a new panic.
Higher-level deferred handler may recover it.
Function returns result + error.
Caller checks err != nil.
errors.New creates simple value.
fmt.Errorf creates formatted value.
Description should explain the failure.
Package-level developer-defined errors use Err prefix.
Example: ErrDivByZero / ErrDivByOne.
errors.Is identifies a known error.
switch selects different recovery behavior.
Default branch handles unexpected error.
Custom struct stores diagnostic fields.
Error() string makes it satisfy error interface.
errors.As obtains typed error instance.
Caller reads fields such as numerator/denominator.
Use when plain text is not enough.
Low level may lack enough context to handle failure.
Return error upward instead of replacing cause.
fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err) wraps cause.
errors.Unwrap exposes lower-level error.
Chain preserves cause + higher-level context.
Expected/recoverable failure → return error.
Panic path → ensure required defer is registered first.
Recover only in a deliberate deferred handler.
Known values → errors.Is; structured type → errors.As.
Need context without losing cause → wrap with %w.
Ignore err → silently continue with bad result.
Place defer after panic point → cleanup never registers.
Use only text when structured diagnostic data is required.
Create new error at each layer → lose original cause.
Recover without a plan → hides an application failure path.

svg.text: Acceptance: distinguish error vs panic, explain defer/recover, classify custom errors, and preserve nested causes.
Key APIs from source: panic • recover • errors.New • errors.Is • errors.As • errors.Unwrap • fmt.Errorf with %w.
